# Noise-Rate-Activated Sensing

> Rate diversity changes the optimal precision law of quantum sensing under a shared fixed unknown transverse error direction. The scientific account distinguishes local information, global minimax risk, and exact stopped-channel guarantees.

## Shared learning route
- [Learning entrypoint](learning/README.md): One reader-independent route through the project.
- [30 milestones](learning/MILESTONES.md): M01–M13 develop the background; M14–M30 connect the research mechanisms and complete scientific meaning. Each target includes dependencies and sources.
- [Haase bridge](learning/HAASE_BRIDGE.md): The sole selected anchor, arXiv:1807.11882v4; source sections, notation, rate normalization, and locally supplied connections.
- [Worked tutorial](learning/TUTORIAL.md): Ramsey likelihood, logical code, nuisance projection, a complete rate-diversity example, stopped channel, and the route to universal and global bounds.

Use the milestones for dependency order and the bridge for source translation. One educational anchor does not replace primary-source attribution. These shared pages contain no personal assessment history or coaching contract.

## Scientific entry points
- [Scientific route](science/README.md): Dependency-ordered topic map of the full scientific account.
- [Overview](README.md): Central results, scope, reading routes, and purpose/contact.
- [Scientific synthesis](science/interpretation.md): Unified contribution, claim-to-proof map, resource distinctions, and scientific scope.
- [Model](science/model.md): Allowed controls, shared nuisance, full Fisher pooling, charged time, and parameter normalization.
- [Local theorems](science/precision_bounds.md): All-strategy fixed-rate converse, optimal selectable-setting coefficient, preset attainment, and independent-axis bound.
- [Global precision](science/global_precision.md): Same-metric minimax comparison, van Trees lower bounds valid for biased estimators, and matching global scalings.
- [Preset protocols](science/preset_protocols.md): Balanced echo, calibration penalty, recorded rate randomization, unknown-rate blocks, and finite-time local certificates.
- [Stopped sensing](science/stopped_sensing.md): Exact Ramsey channel, first-passage law, deadline accounting, and global achievability.
- [Physical scope](science/physical_scope.md): Collision and stochastic models, coherent-access distinction, signal shifts, and finite-cadence local result.
- [Microscopic sensing](science/microscopic_sensing.md): Exact bounded-collision instrument and attainable local coefficient; companion complete-record error and bounded-loss comparison.
- [Microscopic precision](science/microscopic_precision.md): All-controls fixed-coupling converse, matching recovery coefficient, and optimal two-coupling coefficient for boundary-only controls. With n cells and at most n−1 total contacts, at most m inside-cell contacts give optimal local information of order h²(n+m²), for fixed g,h. Adaptive upper bound, charged lower constructions and derivative-controlled limits are explicit. No microscopic global-risk separation is asserted.
- [Residual dephasing](science/residual_dephasing.md): Linear asymptotic ceiling from parallel noise and an exact finite-time advantage window for the specified readout.
- [Related work](references/RELATED_WORK.md): Primary-source comparisons and explicit attribution, including global-risk foundations and stronger access models.
- [Bibliography](references/references.bib): Machine-readable references.

## Verification and maintenance
- [Reproducibility](verification/README.md): Commands, check coverage, numerical examples, and evidence-table definitions.
- [Stopped calculations](src/nras.py): Algebra, control speed, timing laws, and event simulator.
- [Preset calculations](src/preset.py): Complete Fisher matrices, calibration laws, and labelled-design coefficients.
- [Risk and dephasing calculations](src/risk.py): Global lower bounds, fixed-rate upper scaling, and dephased preset information.
- [Stopped tests](tests/test_nras.py): Symbolic identities, trajectories, optimization, and deadline-aware samples.
- [Preset tests](tests/test_preset.py): Echo trajectories, likelihood finite differences, rate uncertainty, and randomization bounds.
- [Risk tests](tests/test_risk.py): Prior and bound ingredients, estimator check, mixed-state likelihood, resource identities, and deterministic evidence regeneration.
- [Learning checks](tests/test_learning.py): Finite checks of tutorial examples, probability readout, exposure accounting, and source-rate normalization.
- [Evidence tables](results/evidence.json): Exact formula evaluations generated by scripts/reproduce_evidence.py; bounds are not exact risks.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Authorized repository, scientific invariants, and maintenance workflow.

Treat proof documents as the claim definitions, not test counts as universal evidence. Pool complete Fisher matrices before eliminating a shared nuisance. Preset rate choice is not feedback-free when recovery follows errors. Distinguish local information, global risk, and exact output independence; charge every repetition and failure. Neither the optimal global constant nor arbitrary-noise fault tolerance is claimed. Bath-output access, indefinite causal order, and a coherent unknown-axis drive are outside the central model. Do not infer priority or experimental demonstration from finite checks.
